quest.title: The Gift of a Lantern
quest.description: Ms. Bai from Qingce Village seems to be making some preparations...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I hope he'll like that Xiao Lantern...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: How do you do, Traveler? Thanks for your help last time. Qingce Village hasn't been this lively in a while now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're most welcome.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: In previous years, only Zhi and I were around, so we could only make the children a few Xiao Lanterns, talk to the old folks about some domestic business, and whip up a few good dishes...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: But with your help, we were able to have a lively Lantern Rite this time.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: But I guess we should look to return to normal now... I should see to the elderly folk in the village. I'm meant to go see Jiangcheng today.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you come along with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lead the way.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Alright. Then let us go to his place first.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Is it you, dear? Are you back?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, you must've mistaken me for someone else...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Nonsense, I haven't lost my senses... How could I not recognize my own wife...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: I was just telling you that, with such a huge festival just around the corner, maybe we should get some new clothes for our daughter...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Oh, I see you've brought a guest... A seamstress! Once again, you've read my mind!

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Grandpa Jiangcheng, it's me, Ms. Bai! I brought you some Tofu the other day, surely you haven't forgotten me already?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Ah... Ms. Bai... Of course I remember you, Ms. Bai! Your father was telling me how proud he is of you not so long ago...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Eh... When was that? ...Dear, perhaps you remember...

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: Ha! Just like I said, there's nothing wrong with my memory... And, and...

response.speaker: Ms. Bai
response.text: Grandpa Jiangcheng, why don't you take some rest? No need to strain yourself...

response.speaker: Ms. Bai
response.text: Traveler, how about you help Grandpa Jiangcheng clean the house? I'll keep him company in the meantime.

talks.objective: Use Anemo or Hydro to help Jiangcheng clean the house

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Dear, come have a word with Ms. Bai... Her father is such a skilled craftsman...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: They sell their Tofu in Liyue Harbor, it's top-quality!

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Right! Ms. Bai, I forgot to ask what brought you here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We brought you a Xiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Xiao Lantern... Ah... So considerate. You bring me those each year, Ms. Bai...

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Do you remember, Dear? I used to make great Xiao Lanterns back in the day. Our neighbors liked them so much that they asked me to make some for them too.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Xiao Lanterns are so beautiful, they really light up each Lantern Rite... Wait, I'll hang it for you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me hang it up.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Alright, just be careful. Don't hurt yourself...

talks.objective: Hang the Xiao Lantern on the house

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I'm really grateful for your help. If I'd gone there on my own, it would've taken me hours to get everything done.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I didn't want to leave Grandpa Jiangcheng on his own right before the festival...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about you...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Me... I'm going back to the mill. There's still much work to be done.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I inherited the mill when my father passed away. I left my job at Liyue Harbor to continue the family tradition.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I don't know if it makes sense, but doing the same things he used to do, being in the same environment, it makes me very nostalgic.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I often recall the many things that my father used to tell me, especially during this time of the year...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Oh, I almost forgot. With Grandpa Jiangcheng on my mind, I didn't make a Xiao Lantern for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: The problem is I didn't leave any spare materials either...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I'm afraid I won't get everything done in time if I go looking for materials now... Traveler, would you mind collecting some for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not at all.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I really appreciate it.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Did you hang the Xiao Lantern? Truly breathtaking. The upcoming year is bound to be another great one.

response.speaker: Ms. Bai
response.text: Grandpa Jiangcheng, it's time for us to leave now. We still have a few errands to run. I'll visit you again soon.

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: I see... Young people like you always have something to do... Can't get a moment's respite...

response.speaker: Jiangcheng
response.text: Ah, sure. Dear... don't forget to look after our land...

talks.objective: Follow Ms. Bai back to the mill
Collect Xiao Lantern materials for Ms. Bai

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This house should pass the white glove test now! Let's go check on Ms. Bai and Grandpa Jiangcheng...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, let's go back and join them.

talks.objective: Give Xiao Lantern materials to Ms. Bai

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: It's you, Ms. Bai... Has your father been well?

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Uh... He... He's doing fine. The mill is still very much in business. The city folk from Liyue Harbor often come to the village just to buy our Tofu.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Haha... Sounds about right! Your father's Tofu is the pride of Qingce Village...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. I'll make myself a Xiao Lantern later.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: I used to release Xiao Lanterns together with my father. When I'm done making this one, I'll have to release it on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: But I hope... he'll be able to see it.

choices.text: He definitely will be able to see it.

response.speaker: Ms. Bai
response.text: Thank you so much. I wish you Happy Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Have you gathered the materials yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, I have them right here.

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: Xiao Lanterns... Xiao Lanterns... Such a wonderful sight...

dialogues.speaker: Ms. Bai
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you hang the Xiao Lantern now? I'll look after Grandpa Jiangcheng.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangcheng
dialogues.text: What a pretty Xiao Lantern! The upcoming year is bound to be as great as this one.
